name: propose_operator_knowledge
title: Propose shared Operator knowledge
description: During an open owner message or answer, propose an agreement replacement or a principle put or removal with the current expected_revision. Writes nothing until an owner approves in the inbox. What a setting can express (gate, label, permission, priority, limit) goes to operate instead.

change.description: A null principle id gets a server id. Propose a rule only after a repeated failure and name the cards in its reason; refer to a duty or role, not a member name. Never import principles automatically from memory or documents.

operations.description: Recommended operations, only for the Operator’s agreement_replace (at most ten). Even immediate ones wait for this approval; protected configuration operations still need a separate approval.
